_what: The conditionVocabulary each classifyZone header serves. The 144.0.0 measurement (2026-10-30, build beb6b930: every metric of that corpus that offers classifyZone, at the anchor and the lower rung) carried forward verbatim, plus the one classifyZone home contract 146.0.0 added: MKT_ABOVE_EMA on a MARKET section (marketScope crypto, BTC, 1h anchor, 2026-11-02 at 146.0.1, build a07740c0; data/audit/market_section_probe_146_2026-11-02.json probe D.MKT_ABOVE_EMA.classifyZone) - risk-off / neutral / risk-on. PAR_DEV also serves classifyZone in its hint but no section subject reads it, so its zone header cannot be rendered (`_subjects_146.json`). omega.fanout reads `byMetric`. Supersedes zone_vocabulary_144_2026-10-30.json. Also the three classifyZone homes 146 added on existing metrics - CVD, CUM_VOLUME_DELTA and SPOT_CVD (their hints serve classifyZone since 146; bullish / bearish / neutral, banded at 0), rendered together with REGIME_STATE x value on an evaluated-coin section (BTC, 1h, 2026-11-02 at 146.0.1): `probe146` holds that render's outputs and first row verbatim.
